## What's Changed * optimize Metal GPU rendering: collapse render passes, remove debug shader branches, remove unused depth buffer — 34% GPU frame time reduction [#510](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/510) * overlay improvements: refactor rendering to simplify threading, add track position to credits, align FPS with speed icons, fix vertical jitter and crash on F2 stats [#500](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/500) [#517](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/517) [#518](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/518) [#519](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/519) * fix quota handling, get new quota every time we switch playlists instead of only daily [#512](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/512) [#503](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/503) * avoid sign-out during transient server outages [#325](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/325) * faster startup [#513](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/513) [#482](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/482) [#505](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/505)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.14.5...0.14.6
